steps.text: To add a note, click Note at the top. It's available from any tab.
Write your note and save it. Like before, it starts as a draft.
Your note shows up right away under Recent Activity.
This badge counts the drafts that still need approval.
If you're allowed to approve notes, you can do it right here, without leaving the Overview.
The count updates as soon as you approve.
Timeline and Notes has the full history, and you can sort it however you like.
To print the notes, use the menu at the top.
